name: Eridan Ampora
source:
Making his Pesterquest debut in Volume 10 alongside Feferi, Eridan was first met in Homestuck.

Because of his rather high position on the hemospectrum, Eridan is rather full of himself, and is very prone to driving people away, and this bothers him more than he usually cares to admit.
